description: Create a deterministic lowercase hexadecimal MD5 hash from text. Missing or null input is treated as empty text before its UTF-8 bytes are hashed.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to hash. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: hash
outputs.description: Returns the deterministic lowercase hexadecimal MD5 hash of the input's UTF-8 bytes.

description: Create a deterministic lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 hash from text. Missing or null input is treated as empty text before its UTF-8 bytes are hashed.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to hash. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: hash
outputs.description: Returns the deterministic lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 hash of the input's UTF-8 bytes.

description: Create a deterministic lowercase hexadecimal SHA-512 hash from text. Missing or null input is treated as empty text before its UTF-8 bytes are hashed.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to hash. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: hash

description: Check whether text contains only ASCII letters. Missing or null input is treated as empty text and returns false.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to check. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: is_alpha
outputs.description: Returns true only when the text is non-empty and contains only ASCII letters.

description: Check whether text contains only ASCII letters and digits. Missing or null input is treated as empty text and returns false.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to check. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: is_alphanumeric
outputs.description: Returns true only when the text is non-empty and contains only ASCII letters and digits.

description: Check whether text matches the supported email format. Missing or null input is treated as empty text and returns false.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Email text to check. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: is_email
outputs.description: Returns true when the text matches the supported email format and false otherwise.

description: Check whether text contains a substring. Each missing or null input is treated as empty text.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text to search. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

inputs.name: substring
inputs.description: Text to find. Missing or null input is treated as empty text.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Returns true when Value contains Substring after missing or null inputs are replaced with empty text.

description: Check whether text matches a regular expression. Missing or null inputs use empty text.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Text to match. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.description: Regular expression to apply to the value. Missing or null input uses an empty pattern.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: True when the complete value matches the regular expression.

description: Compare two text values without considering letter case. Missing or null inputs use empty text.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: First text value to compare. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: other
inputs.description: Second text value to compare. Missing or null input uses empty text.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: True when both text values are equal without considering letter case.
